sections.h2: Maize ethanol now carries the highest procurement price of any feedstock

sections.means: Maize's price rose faster than any other feedstock, reflecting the push to diversify beyond sugarcane.
sections.todo: Raise maize yields, which the post puts at about 3.3 tonnes a hectare against roughly 11 in the US.
